title: Make one small thing better

purpose.objective: Choose and complete one small, observable improvement.
purpose.meaning: Create a useful result without turning progress into pressure or a measure of personal worth.

options.title: Organize one item
options.description: Clarify the location or name of one file, note, or project element.

options.title: Verify one claim
options.description: Trace one statement to its source and record what is known and unknown.

options.title: Test one behavior
options.description: Run one small reproducible test and record the actual result.

steps.instruction: Choose one option, change it to fit your circumstances, or pause the quest.
Work only on the chosen small improvement. Stop when the defined result is reached or the effort limit feels too high.
Record one of: completed, partly completed, paused, or blocked. Note the useful result or the next smallest step.

success_criteria: One option was freely selected or adapted.
The outcome is recorded honestly as completed, partly completed, paused, or blocked.
No personal score, streak, or public ranking is required.

deliverables.description: One changed file, source note, or passing test result; alternatively a short reflection if no artifact was appropriate.

feedback.method: Show the selected action, the actual result, and one useful next step. Do not invent success.

rewards.description: A quiet completion marker for the work actually done; no score is assigned to mood or personal worth.
